setting_auto_set_output_path: Output directory automatically follows input (ignore fixed setting)
setting_enable_background_prewarm_desc: After the main menu opens, gradually load regular text translation dependencies in the background. MangaCore, visual models, and manga runtimes are not prewarmed; turn this off on low-memory devices.
setting_enable_context_enhancement_desc: Preserve source context when splitting mid-paragraph, improves coherence (slightly increases token usage)
setting_chunk_soft_limit_extra_lines_des: In line mode, allows the last few lines to merge into the previous request to reduce tiny batches and context breaks. Example: with 50 lines/request, 56 remaining lines can be sent as 56. Set 0 to disable.
setting_line_split_optimization_mode_des: Dynamic split mode slightly increases nearby final batches so the task can reach the end directly and reduce isolated tiny batches.
setting_line_split_optimization_mode_tai: Tail split mode dynamically adjusts nearby final batches until the final remainder is no larger than the small-tail merge extra lines, then lets tail merging handle it.
setting_retry_split_min_lines_desc: When a failed batch is retried in later rounds, line batches will not be reduced below this value. Example: default 20 lines can fall to 15 at minimum; values already below it are not increased.
setting_sdk_request_mode_desc: Switch request implementation: HTTPX -> OpenAI SDK -> Anthropic SDK -> Google SDK. Anthropic SDK means the Anthropic protocol and is not limited to Claude models; Google SDK uses the official Google GenAI SDK.
setting_use_openai_sdk_desc: Legacy compatibility setting; use SDK Request Mode to switch between HTTPX, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, and Google SDK.
setting_enable_stream_api_desc: Smart detection of API streaming support, auto-detect on first request and cache result
setting_enable_prompt_caching_desc: Cache system prompts and glossaries to significantly reduce API costs (Anthropic/Google/Bedrock)
setting_enable_async_mode_desc: Use aiohttp async requests, ideal for high concurrency (100+), reduces thread switching overhead
setting_enable_rate_limit_desc: Strictly limit request rate when enabled, may slow down translation, suitable for APIs with strict quotas
setting_custom_rpm_limit_desc: Max requests per minute, 0 uses platform default
setting_custom_tpm_limit_desc: Max tokens per minute, 0 uses platform default

option_glossary_analysis_full_desc: For large-context models such as 1M. Sends the selected range to the LLM in one request so it can analyze terms with global context, usually with better accuracy.
option_glossary_analysis_split_desc: For smaller-context models such as 128K. Splits the selected text by line count into multiple requests and may lose global context; use mainly for older models.
msg_glossary_token_warning_title: The selected text estimate exceeds the warning threshold
msg_glossary_token_warning_detail: Current estimate is about {0:,} tokens. The quality warning threshold is {1:,} tokens. Even models with a nominal 1M context window can lose attention on long-context tasks, causing low-frequency terms, early settings, or character changes to be missed.
msg_glossary_incremental_split_differenc: If accepted, this will use same-file incremental merging: later batches refer to the accumulated glossary and rules from earlier batches. If there is no obvious change, the model may return empty results; if there is a clear change, it must update the state before merging. Automatic splitting defaults to about 200000 tokens per batch, and custom targets are capped at 256000 tokens per batch. It will not write Vol_2, Vol_3, or volume-number timeline markers, and it will not cut sentences just to split.
msg_glossary_token_warning_soft_note: This is only a soft warning. If you decline, analysis will continue as a full single-pass request.
confirm_glossary_auto_incremental_split: Switch to automatic incremental split analysis?
confirm_glossary_analysis_translate_dire: Ask the LLM to output translations and notes during analysis?
msg_glossary_analysis_translate_enabled: Analysis-time translation is enabled: the LLM will output translations and notes.
msg_token_reference_note: Token count is only a reference; the actual range is still selected by line count/percentage and does not use translation token mode.
msg_single_request_analysis: Full book / percentage extraction: sends the selected text to the LLM in one request.
msg_split_request_analysis: Split extraction: splits the selected text into line-based batches.
msg_incremental_split_request_analysis: Long incremental split: splits the selected text sequentially, asks each batch to output only new or changed items, and merges the results batch by batch.
msg_incremental_split_sequential_note: This mode runs sequentially. Each later batch refers to the accumulated glossary, character, and worldbuilding snapshot from earlier batches. Splitting happens only at original text-item or sentence-end boundaries, so sentences are not cut. The batch target can be customized, but each batch is capped at 256000 tokens. It also will not write Vol_2/Vol_3-style volume history.
